title: Clarity of Scripture
definition: The clarity of Scripture is the truth that God's Word can be understood by ordinary believers through careful study, dependence upon the Holy Spirit, and proper interpretation.
summary: God has revealed His truth in a way that can be understood and applied by His people.
christFocus: Jesus taught Scripture openly and expected people to understand and obey God's revealed truth.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
God did not give Scripture to confuse His people but to reveal Himself. While some passages require careful study and mature understanding, the central message of the Bible is clear. The Gospel, God's character, humanity's need for salvation, and the call to faith and obedience are understandable to those who approach Scripture with humility.

The clarity of Scripture does not mean every passage is equally easy to interpret. It means that God has communicated His truth sufficiently for believers to know Him and follow Him.

The Holy Spirit helps believers understand and apply God's Word, and the church benefits from teachers, pastors, and study resources that aid in interpretation.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many believers feel intimidated when reading the Bible and assume only scholars can understand it. This doctrine encourages Christians to approach Scripture with confidence and expectancy.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Read Scripture consistently and prayerfully. When you encounter difficult passages, compare Scripture with Scripture, seek wise counsel, and continue studying rather than becoming discouraged.
